t: Step into strength and style with the women’s Skarn honey steel toe cap safety boots built for protection without compromising comfort. Crafted from premium nubuck leather with breathable mesh panels, these boots keep your feet cool and supported all day. The dual-density, shock-absorbing sole and cushioned collar and tongue deliver lasting comfort, while the 200J steel toe cap and steel midsole provide trusted protection against impact and penetration. Designed with a wide fit and oil-repellent, anti-static sole, they offer excellent grip and stability on any surface. Durable, dependable, and effortlessly stylish making these boots ideal for work or everyday wear.
b: Not Tested for Sole Heat Resistance
